skill.name: community-marketing
skill.description: Plan community launches, onboarding, engagement rituals, ambassador programs, and health audits using audience goals and community stage.
skill.summary: Create practical community strategies that connect member value with product growth and retention.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All four static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting or ordinary community-building advice. The reviewed files provide strategy instructions, supporting reference material, and evaluation scenarios. No evidence found of malicious instruction overrides, credential theft, or data exfiltration.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 15 uses inline Markdown backticks around optional local context filenames. It requests reading product context, not shell execution or command substitution.
SKILL.md lines 56 through 60 contain a fenced text diagram showing member participation and community discovery. The backticks delimit Markdown, with no executable commands.
Line 60 closes the community diagram; line 103 formats a reference filename with inline backticks. The intervening playbooks contain prose, not executable shell or Ruby code.
SKILL.md lines 46 and 47 list member benefits: exclusive knowledge, early access, and peer connections. These describe community value, not network probing or reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Communities often struggle to turn new members into active participants and advocates. This skill creates stage-specific plans for launches, onboarding, engagement, and measurable community health.
actual_capabilities: Compare community platforms by audience fit, discovery, searchability, and management trade-offs.
Draft community strategy documents with member identity, a participation loop, and a 90-day launch plan.
Propose channel structures, posting guidelines, welcome sequences, and first-week prompts.
Design recurring discussion threads, events, and member recognition activities.
Outline ambassador selection, benefits, personal outreach, and referral measurement.
Interpret supplied community metrics to produce health diagnoses and three improvement priorities.
limitations: Provides written plans; it does not create servers, configure channels, send messages, or moderate members automatically.
Does not collect live platform analytics; health audits depend on metrics and context you supply.
Reference benchmarks are illustrative and are not independently verified or guaranteed for your community.
Related skills are references, not bundled functionality; additional guidance may require separate skills.

use_cases.title: Launch a founder-led community
use_cases.description: Choose a platform, recruit founding members, establish participation norms, and create a practical launch schedule.

use_cases.title: Improve member activation
use_cases.description: Diagnose onboarding gaps and plan welcome sequences, recurring discussions, and recognition for helpful members.

use_cases.title: Plan community-led support
use_cases.description: Develop peer support routines, knowledge base priorities, and feedback processes that connect recurring questions with product improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a community platform
prompt_templates.prompt: We serve [audience] with [product]. Compare Slack, Discord, and one alternative for [community goal]. Recommend a platform and explain its main trade-offs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: selecting a platform before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Design the first member experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Our [platform] community has [member count] members and serves [audience]. Draft a welcome post, channel structure, and first-week participation prompts for [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Audit community health
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our [stage] community using these weekly metrics: [metrics]. Identify likely participation gaps and three priorities. Propose a four-week ritual calendar and flag missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: diagnosing low engagement from supplied metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a scalable ambassador program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ambassador program for [audience] with [member count] members and [weekly management hours]. Include selection criteria, benefits, outreach, measurement, and responsibilities as membership grows.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: developing member leadership and advocacy.

output_examples.input: We have 40 members in a new Slack community, but only three post regularly. Suggest priorities for the next month.
output: Priority 1: Ask recent members what they hoped to gain, then simplify the welcome path around one useful first action.
Priority 2: Publish a weekly problem-solving thread and personally invite relevant members to contribute.
Priority 3: Track seven-day posting rates and unanswered threads weekly to assess whether participation becomes broader.

output_examples.input: Our 5,000-member product community has several regular helpers. Outline an ambassador program.
output: Selection: Invite members who consistently provide useful answers, welcome newcomers, and recommend the product without prompting.
Benefits: Offer recognition, direct product feedback sessions, and resources that help ambassadors support peers.
Outreach: Send personal invitations that explain which contributions stood out and what participation involves.
Measurement: Review referral signups, helpful replies, and ambassador participation monthly before expanding the program.

best_practices: Provide your audience, platform, community stage, primary goal, and available management time before requesting a plan.
Define clear member value and one repeatable participation action before adding channels or recruitment campaigns.
Review weekly engagement metrics alongside member feedback, and adapt tactics to your community stage.
anti_patterns: Treating membership totals as proof of community health while ignoring replies, participation, and member value.
Opening many channels before establishing regular conversations and a clear onboarding path.
Copying large-community benchmarks or ambassador incentives without considering your stage, audience, and management capacity.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It drafts strategy documents, channel plans, member journeys, ritual calendars, ambassador briefs, and community health reports.

faq.question: Does it manage Discord or Slack automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations and written materials, without built-in platform integrations or automated moderation.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Share your product, audience, platform, member count, primary goal, and weekly management capacity. Include metrics when requesting a health audit.

faq.question: Can I use it before launching a community?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers platform selection, founding member recruitment, community norms, seeded discussions, and launch planning.

faq.question: Can it measure community health without my data?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest metrics and identify missing information, but it cannot retrieve live analytics or verify outcomes.

faq.question: Does it use existing product marketing context?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for an existing local product marketing context document and uses that information before asking additional questions.
